01 . This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

The petitioner Ramakanta Bhoi has filed this writ petition with a prayer to direct the opposite party no.2- the Collector & District Magistrate, Bhadrak to immediately compensate the petitioner for the land utilized for the construction of the road in accordance with the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, 2013 with a further prayer to halt all further construction activities on the petitioner's land until the compensation is finalized and paid with a further prayer to decide his grievance petition dated 18.11.2024 within a stipulated time.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner has submitted a representation highlighting the grievances before the opposite party no.2- the Collector & District Magistrate,
Bhadrak on 18.11.2024, but he has not received any communication from the concerned Authority relating to the status of the representation and therefore, a direction may be given to dispose of the same within a specified period.

sentences.text: 1 Learned counsel for the State has no objection to such submission.

Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the respective parties, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, we dispose of the writ petition directing the opposite party no.2- the Collector & District Magistrate, Bhadrak to take a decision on the representation filed by the petitioner vide Annexure-2 and pass appropriate order in accordance with law within a period of three months from the date of production of a certified copy of this order and to communicate the order to the petitioner within a period of two weeks of taking the decision.
Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.
( S.K. Sahoo) Judge ( Chittaranjan Dash) Judge RKM Signed by: RABINDRA KUMAR MISHRA Location: HIGH COURT OF ORISSA, CUTTACK Date: 10-Jan-2025 18:21:53
